analysisExcludedFolders.description: An array of paths to be excluded from Dart analysis. This option should usually be set at the Workspace level. Excluded folders will also be ignored when detecting project types.

analyzerAdditionalArgs.description: Additional arguments to pass to the Dart Analysis Server. This setting is can be useful for troubleshooting issues with the Dart Analysis Server.

analyzerVmAdditionalArgs.description: Additional arguments to pass to the VM running the Dart Analysis Server. This setting is can be useful for troubleshooting issues with the Dart Analysis Server.

analyzerDiagnosticsPort.description: The port number to be used for the Dart analyzer diagnostic server. This setting is can be useful for troubleshooting issues with the Dart Analysis Server.

analyzerPath.description: The path to a custom Dart Analysis Server. This setting is intended for use by Dart Analysis Server developers. Use `~` to insert the user's home directory (the path should then use `/` separators even on Windows).

analyzerSshHost.description: An SSH host to run the Analysis Server. This can be useful when modifying code on a remote machine using SSHFS.

analyzerVmServicePort.description: The port number to be used for the Dart Analysis Server VM service. This setting is intended for use by Dart Analysis Server developers.

includeDependenciesInWorkspaceSymbols.description: Whether to include symbols from the SDK and package dependencies in the "Go to Symbol in Workspace" (`cmd/ctrl`+`T`) list. This can only be disabled when using Dart 3.0 / Flutter 3.10 or later.

notifyAnalyzerErrors.description: Whether to show a notification the first few times an Analysis Server exception occurs.

showTodos.description: Whether to show TODOs in the Problems list. Can be a boolean to enable all TODO comments (TODO, FIXME, HACK, UNDONE) or an array of which types to enable. Older Dart SDKs may not support some TODO kinds.

showExtensionRecommendations.description: Whether to show recommendations for other VS Code extensions based on the packages you're using.

devToolsBrowser.description: Whether to launch external DevTools windows using Chrome or the system default browser. This setting is ignored for remote workspaces (including Docker, SSH, WSL).

devToolsPort.description: The port number to be used for the Dart DevTools (requires restart).

devToolsReuseWindows.description: Whether to try to reuse existing DevTools windows instead of launching new ones. Only works for instances of DevTools launched by the DevTools server on the local machine.

devToolsTheme.description: The theme to use for Dart DevTools.

openDevTools.description: Whether to automatically open DevTools at the start of a debug session. If embedded DevTools is enabled, this will launch the Widget Inspector embedded for Flutter projects, or launch DevTools externally in a browser for Dart projects.

closeDevTools.description: Whether to automatically close embedded DevTools tabs when a debug session ends.

shareDevToolsWithFlutter.description: Whether to eagerly run DevTools for Flutter workspaces and share the spawned server with `flutter run`.

showInspectorNotificationsForWidgetError.description: Whether to show notifications for widget errors that offer Inspect Widget links. This requires that the `#dart.shareDevToolsWithFlutter#` setting is also enabled.

customDevTools.description: Custom settings for launching DevTools. This setting is intended for use by Dart DevTools developers.

path.description: The root directory containing a clone of the flutter/devtools repository.

args.description: Extra arguments to pass when running the `devtools_tool serve` command.

env.description: Any environment variables to set when spawning the command. 'LOCAL_DART_SDK' should usually be set to your Dart SDK checkout and 'FLUTTER_ROOT' to the version of Flutter that DevTools is pinned to.

autoImportCompletions.description: Whether to include symbols that have not been imported in the code completion list and automatically insert the required import when selecting them (requires restart).

automaticCommentSlashes.description: Determines when to insert comment slashes when pressing `<enter>` in the editor (requires restart). When using `tripleSlash`, double-slashes will still be included when breaking existing double-slash comments across additional lines.

closingLabels.description: Whether to show annotations against constructor, method invocations and lists that span multiple lines.

closingLabelsPrefix.description: The prefix to use in closing labels.

closingLabelsTextStyle.description: The text style to use in closing labels. Using _Italic_ requires a font that supports italic text.

completeFunctionCalls.description: Whether to insert parentheses and placeholders for positional and required arguments during code completions when using LSP. This feature is automatically disabled if commit characters are enabled.

documentation.description: What level of documentation to show in Hovers and Code Completion details. When `null`, defaults to 'full' when running locally and 'none' in remote workspaces. This setting is only supported for Dart SDKs after v2.18.

dtdEditorActiveLocationDelay.description: How long (in ms) to delay sending editor location change events over the Dart Tooling Daemon. Increasing this results in less events which may improve performance, at the expensive of tools that use these events not updating as quickly after your location/editor changes (requires restart).

enableServerSnippets.description: Whether to use code snippets from the Dart Analysis Server instead of those included in the extension. Server snippets are context and language-version aware and should be preferred.

hotReloadPatterns.description: An array of glob patterns that should trigger Hot Reload when saved. The pattern is matched against the absolute path of the file. enableCompletionCommitCharacters.description: Whether to automatically commit the selected completion item when pressing certain keys such as . , ( and \[. This setting does not currently apply to LSP, see `#dart.previewCommitCharacters#`.

enableSdkFormatter.description: Whether to enable the [dart_style](https://pub.dev/packages/dart_style) formatter for Dart code.

enableSnippets.description: Whether to include Dart and Flutter snippets in code completion.

inlayHints.description: Whether to show Inlay Hints. When set to `true`, enables all inlay hints with default settings. When set to `false`, disables all inlay hints. Can also be an object to configure individual hint types. Requires Dart 3.10.

enabled.description: Whether to show Inlay Hints for dot shorthand types.

Whether to show Inlay Hints for inferred return types.

Whether to show Inlay Hints for inferred variable declarations.

insertArgumentPlaceholders.description: Whether to insert argument placeholders during code completions. This feature is automatically disabled when `enableCompletionCommitCharacters` is enabled.

lspSnippetTextEdits.description: Whether to enable [Snippet support in LSP TextEdits](https://github.com/rust-analyzer/rust-analyzer/blob/979e788957ced1957ee9ac1da70fb97abf9fe2b1/docs/dev/lsp-extensions.md#snippet-textedit).

lspCachingMiddleware.description: Whether to enable caching of some LSP responses in the client to reduce duplicate requests to the analysis server.

showDartPadSampleCodeLens.description: Whether to show CodeLens actions in the editor for opening online DartPad samples.

showMainCodeLens.description: Whether to show CodeLens actions in the editor for quick running / debugging scripts with main functions.

showTestCodeLens.description: Whether to show CodeLens actions in the editor for quick running / debugging tests.

updateImportsOnRename.description: Whether to automatically update imports when moving or renaming files. Currently only supports single file moves / renames.

warnWhenEditingFilesOutsideWorkspace.description: Whether to show a warning when modifying files outside of the workspace.

warnWhenEditingFilesInPubCache.description: Whether to show a warning when modifying files in the [system package cache](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/glossary#system-cache) directory.

flutterAdbConnectOnChromeOs.description: Whether to automatically run `adb connect 100.115.92.2:5555` when spawning the Flutter daemon when running on Chrome OS.

flutterAdditionalArgs.description: Additional args to pass to all `flutter` commands including `flutter daemon`. Do not use this to pass arguments to your Flutter app, use the `args` field in a `launch.json` or the `#dart.flutterRunAdditionalArgs#` setting.

flutterAttachAdditionalArgs.description: Additional args to pass to the `flutter attach` command. Using the `args`/`toolArgs` fields in `launch.json` is usually better than this setting as this setting will apply to _all_ projects.

flutterCreateAndroidLanguage.description: The programming language to use for Android apps when creating new projects using the 'Flutter: Create New Project' command.

flutterCreateIOSLanguage.description: The programming language to use for iOS apps when creating new projects using the 'Flutter: Create New Project' command. This is only supported up until Flutter 3.22 after which it will be ignored.

flutterCreatePlatforms.description: The platforms to enable for new projects created using the 'Flutter: Create New Project' command. If unset, all platforms will be enabled.

flutterCreatePromptForPlatforms.description: Whether to prompt for platforms when running 'Flutter: Create New Project'.

flutterCreateOrganization.description: The organization responsible for your new Flutter project, in reverse domain name notation (e.g. `com.google`). flutterCustomEmulators.description: Custom emulators to show in the emulator list for easier launching. If IDs match existing emulators returned by Flutter, the custom emulators will override them.

flutterGutterIcons.description: Whether to show Flutter icons and colors in the editor gutter.

flutterHotReloadOnSave.description: Whether to automatically send a Hot Reload request to Flutter apps during a debug session when saving files. Dart apps are controlled by the `#dart.hotReloadOnSave#` setting.

flutterGenerateLocalizationsOnSave.description: Whether to automatically run the Generate Localizations command for Flutter apps when saving .arb files.

flutterRunAdditionalArgs.description: Additional args to pass to the `flutter run` command. Using the `args`/`toolArgs` fields in `launch.json` is usually better than this setting as this setting will apply to _all_ projects.

flutterScreenshotPath.description: The path to a directory to save Flutter screenshots. Use `~` to insert the user's home directory (the path should then use `/` separators even on Windows).

flutterRememberSelectedDevice.description: Whether to remember which device was last (explicitly) selected for each project. flutterSelectDeviceWhenConnected.description: Whether to set newly connected devices as the current device in Flutter projects.

flutterTestAdditionalArgs.description: Additional args to pass to the `flutter test` command. Using the `args`/`toolArgs` fields in `launch.json` is usually better than this setting as this setting will apply to _all_ projects.

flutterWebRenderer.description: Sets the [Web renderer](https://flutter.dev/to/web-renderers) used for Flutter web apps.

flutterWidgetPreview.description: Controls whether the Widget Preview is enabled, and if so whether it is started eagerly or lazily. Starting lazily will avoid consuming any resources until you first use the Widget Preview, but will cause the first load to be slower. Requires restart.

flutterWidgetPreviewLocation.description: Where to display the Flutter Widget Preview. Requires restart.

useFlutterDev.description: Whether to use `flutter-dev` instead of `flutter`. This is a script for developers of the `flutter` tool to run from source and will run more slowly than the compiled tool.

maxLogLineLength.description: The maximum length of a line in the log file. Lines longer than this will be truncated and suffixed with an ellipsis.

maxCompletionItems.description: The maximum number of completion items to return from a code completion request. Updated results will be fetched as additional characters are typed. Lower numbers may improved performance. Defaults to a lower value in remote workspaces. Only affects LSP for > Dart SDK 2.17.

enablePub.description: Whether to enable functionality for using Pub. Turning this setting off will prevent the extension from ever running pub and hide all commands relating to this. Use this if you are using an alternative package manager.

offline.description: Whether to use the --offline switch for commands like 'Pub: Get Packages' and 'Flutter: Create New Project'.

promptToGetPackages.description: Whether to prompt to get/upgrade packages when opening a project with missing/out of date packages.

pubAdditionalArgs.description: Additional args to pass to all `pub` commands.

runPubGetOnPubspecChanges.description: Whether to run `pub get` whenever `pubspec.yaml` is saved.

runPubGetOnNestedProjects.description: Whether to automatically run `pub get` on nested projects above or below the one where the pubspec was changed.

runPubConcurrently.description: Whether to run Pub operations across multiple folders concurrently.

buildRunnerAdditionalArgs.description: Additional args to pass to the `build_runner` when building/watching/serving.

cliConsole.description: Whether to run Dart CLI apps in the Debug Console or a terminal. The Debug Console has more functionality because the process is controlled by the debug adapter, but is unable to accept input from the user via stdin.

debugExtensionBackendProtocol.description: The protocol to use for the Dart Debug Extension backend service and injected client. Using WebSockets can improve performance but may fail when connecting through some proxy servers.

debugSdkLibraries.description: Whether to mark Dart SDK libraries (`dart:*`) as debuggable, enabling stepping into them while debugging.

debugExternalPackageLibraries.description: Whether to mark external pub package libraries (including `package:flutter`) as debuggable, enabling stepping into them while debugging.

defaultExceptionPauseMode.description: The default exception pause mode. VS Code may persist settings in existing workspaces, so this only controls the default setting advertised by the debug adapter.

evaluateGettersInDebugViews.description: Whether to evaluate getters in order to display them in debug views (such as the Variables, Watch and Hovers views).

showGettersInDebugViews.description: Whether to show getters in order to display them in debug views (such as the Variables, Watch and Hovers views). If `evaluateGettersInDebugViews` is `true` getters will be eagerly evaluated, otherwise they will require clicking to evaluate.

evaluateToStringInDebugViews.description: Whether to call toString() on objects when rendering them in debug views (such as the Variables, Watch and Hovers views). Only applies to views of 100 or fewer values for performance reasons.

hotReloadOnSave.description: Whether to automatically send a Hot Reload request to Dart apps during a debug session when saving files. Flutter apps are controlled by the `#dart.flutterHotReloadOnSave#` setting.

hotReloadProgress.description: Determines how to display Hot Restart and Hot Reload progress.

promptToRunIfErrors.description: Whether to prompt before running if there are errors in your project. Test scripts will be excluded from the check unless they're the script being run.

showDartDeveloperLogs.description: Whether to show logs from the `dart:developer` `log()` function in the debug console.

showDebuggerNumbersAsHex.description: Whether to show integers formatted as Hex in Variables, Watch, Debug Consoles.

showDevToolsDebugToolBarButtons.description: Whether to show DevTools buttons in the floating Debug toolbar.

suppressTestTimeouts.description: Whether to suppress test timeouts when running/debugging tests. To work properly this requires package:test version 1.20.1 or newer. For older versions, the default timeout will be increased to 1d but this will not affect tests that have explicit (non-factor) timeouts set with @timeout.

cliAdditionalArgs.description: Additional args to pass to the `dart` command when running CLI scripts. Using the `args`/`toolArgs` fields in `launch.json` is usually better than this setting as this setting will apply to _all_ projects.

testAdditionalArgs.description: Additional args to pass to the `dart test` command. Using the `args`/`toolArgs` fields in `launch.json` is usually better than this setting as this setting will apply to _all_ projects.

vmAdditionalArgs.description: Arguments to be passed to the Dart VM when running Dart CLI scripts/tests. These arguments appear after "dart" but before subcommands like "test": `dart (vmAdditionalArgs) test (toolArgs) test/my_test.dart (args)`

customDartDapPath.description: The path to a custom Dart Debug Adapter. This setting is intended for use by Dart Debug Adapter developers. Use `~` to insert the user's home directory (the path should then use `/` separators even on Windows).

customFlutterDapPath.description: The path to a custom Flutter Debug Adapter. This setting is intended for use by Dart Debug Adapter developers. Use `~` to insert the user's home directory (the path should then use `/` separators even on Windows).

checkForSdkUpdates.description: Whether to check you are using the latest version of the Dart SDK at startup.

coverageExcludePatterns.description: An array of glob patterns to exclude from code coverage results. Paths matching any of these patterns will still be collected by the Dart VM but not be included in coverage reported to VS Code.

openTestView.description: When to automatically switch focus to the test list (array to support multiple values).

showSkippedTests.description: Whether to show skipped tests in the test tree.

testInvocationMode.description: How to identify tests when running/debugging. `name` is compatible with older versions of `package:test` but cannot handle some complex/dynamic test names. `line` will prefer to run tests by their line numbers (when available) and fall back to `name` only if the line number is unavailable. `auto` w…

projectSearchDepth.description: How many levels (including the workspace roots) down the workspace to search for Dart/Flutter projects. Increasing this number may help detect Flutter projects that are deeply nested in your workspace but slow down all operations that search for projects, including extension activation (requires re…

env.description: Additional environment variables to be added to all Dart/Flutter processes spawned by the Dart and Flutter extensions.

toolingDaemonAdditionalArgs.description: Additional args to pass to the `dart tooling-daemon` command that runs as a background service (requires restart).

normalizeFileCasing.description: Whether to normalize file casings before sending them to the LSP server. This may fix issues with file_names lints not disappearing after renaming a file if the VS Code API continues to use the original casing.

daemonPort.description: EXPERIMENTAL: The port where flutter daemon can be accessed if daemon is run remotely. This setting is intended for use by Google developers.

previewCommitCharacters.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Whether to enable commit characters for the LSP server. In a future release, the dart.enableCompletionCommitCharacters setting will also apply to LSP.

previewFlutterUiGuides.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Whether to enable the [Flutter UI Guides preview](https://dartcode.org/releases/v3-1/#preview-flutter-ui-guides).

previewFlutterUiGuidesCustomTracking.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Whether to enable custom tracking of Flutter UI guidelines (to hide some latency of waiting for the next Flutter Outline).

previewHotReloadOnSaveWatcher.description: Whether to perform hot reload on save based on a filesystem watcher for Dart files rather than using VS Code's `onDidSave` event. This allows reloads to trigger when external tools modify Dart source files.

experimentalRefactors.description: Whether to enable experimental (possibly unfinished or unstable) refactors on the lightbulb menu. This setting is intended for use by Dart Analysis Server developers or users that want to try out and provide feedback on in-progress refactors.

interactiveForms.description: Whether to enable the Interactive Forms feature used for accepting user input during refactors.

dynamicTestTracking.description: Whether to use the new dynamic test tracking. This is a temporary setting that will be removed in an upcoming release.

experimentalDtdHandlers.description: Whether to enable experimental (possibly unfinished or unstable) LSP handlers through DTD. This setting is passed to the analysis server in the connectToDtd request and therefore relies on DTD being supported and enabled for the analysis server (requires restart).

lineLength.description: **LEGACY SETTING: Use `formatter.page_width` in `analysis_options.yaml` instead.** The maximum length of a line of code. This is used by the document formatter. If you change this value, you may wish to update `editor.rulers` (which draws vertical lines in the editor) in the `["dart"]` section of y…

webDaemonLogFile.description: **LEGACY SETTING: Only applies when using the legacy debug adapters.** The path to a log file for communication between Dart Code and the webdev daemon. This is useful when trying to diagnose issues with launching web apps. Use `${name}` in the log file name to insert the Debug Session name to prev…

onlyAnalyzeProjectsWithOpenFiles.description: **Deprecated**: Whether to ignore workspace folders and perform analysis based on the open files. This setting can make performance significantly worse when moving around a project and is not recommended.

enable.description: Controls if the Deno Language Server is enabled. When enabled, the extension will disable the built-in VSCode JavaScript and TypeScript language services, and will use the Deno Language Server instead. If omitted, your preference will be inferred as true if there is a `deno.json[c]` at your workspa…

cacheOnSave.description: Controls if the extension should cache the active document's dependencies on save.

disablePaths.description: Disables the Deno Language Server for specific paths. This will leave the built in TypeScript/JavaScript language server enabled for those paths. Takes priority over `deno.enablePaths`. **Not recommended to be enabled in user settings.**

enablePaths.description: Enables the Deno Language Server for specific paths, instead of for the whole workspace folder. This will disable the built in TypeScript/JavaScript language server for those paths. When a value is set, the value of `"deno.enable"` is ignored. The workspace folder is used as the base for the suppli…

path.description: A path to the `deno` CLI executable. By default, the extension looks for `deno` in the `PATH`, but if set, will use the path specified instead.

env.description: Additional environment variables to pass to Deno processes. Overrides the user's env and `deno.envFile`. These will be overridden by more specific settings such as `deno.future` for `DENO_FUTURE`, and invariables like `NO_COLOR=1`.

envFile.description: Env file containing additional environment variables to pass to Deno processes. Overrides the user's env. These will be overridden by `deno.env`, more specific settings such as `deno.future` for `DENO_FUTURE`, and invariables like `NO_COLOR=1`.

cache.description: A path to the cache directory for Deno. By default, the operating system's cache path plus `deno` is used, or the `DENO_DIR` environment variable, but if set, this path will be used instead.

certificateStores.description: A list of root certificate stores used to validate TLS certificates when fetching and caching remote resources. This overrides the `DENO_TLS_CA_STORE` environment variable if set.

implementations.description: Enables or disables the display of code lens information for implementations of items in the code.

references.description: Enables or disables the display of code lens information for references of items in the code.

referencesAllFunctions.description: Enables or disables the display of code lens information for all functions in the code.

test.description: Enables or disables the display of code lenses that allow running of individual tests in the code.

testArgs.description: Additional arguments to use with the run test code lens. Defaults to `[ "--allow-all", "--no-check" ]`.

config.description: The file path to a configuration file. This is the equivalent to using `--config` on the command line. The path can be either be relative to the workspace, or an absolute path. It is recommend you name it `deno.json` or `deno.jsonc`. **Not recommended to be set globally.**

documentPreloadLimit.description: Maximum number of file system entries to traverse when finding scripts to preload into TypeScript on startup. Set this to 0 to disable document preloading.

forcePushBasedDiagnostics.description: Disables the server-capability for pull diagnostics to force push-based diagnostics.

future.description: Enable breaking features likely to be shipped in Deno 2.0.

importMap.description: The file path to an import map. This is the equivalent to using `--import-map` on the command line. [Import maps](https://deno.land/manual@v1.6.0/linking_to_external_code/import_maps) provide a way to "relocate" modules based on their specifiers. The path can either be relative to the workspace, or…

maxTsServerMemory.description: Maximum amount of memory the TypeScript isolate can use. Defaults to 3072 (3GB).

autoDiscover.description: If enabled, when new hosts/origins are encountered that support import suggestions, you will be prompted to enable or disable it. Defaults to `true`.

hosts.description: Controls which hosts are enabled for import suggestions.

server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Deno Language Server.

args.description: Arguments to use when running tests via the Test Explorer. Defaults to `[ "--allow-all" ]`.

tlsCertificate.description: A path to a PEM certificate to use as the certificate authority when validating TLS certificates when fetching and caching remote resources. This is like using `--cert` on the Deno CLI and overrides the `DENO_CERT` environment variable if set.

unsafelyIgnoreCertificateErrors.description: **DANGER** disables verification of TLS certificates for the hosts provided. There is likely a better way to deal with any errors than use this option. This is like using `--unsafely-ignore-certificate-errors` in the Deno CLI.

unstable.description: Controls which `--unstable-*` features tests will be run with when running them via the explorer. **Not recommended to be enabled globally.**

lint.description: Controls if linting information will be provided by the Deno Language Server. **Not recommended to be enabled globally.**

enabled.description: Controls if the Deno language server contributes organize imports code actions. Disable to rely on VS Code's built-in TypeScript/JavaScript organize imports instead.
Controls if the Deno language server provides document symbols. Disable to rely on VS Code's built-in providers instead.
Controls if the Deno language server provides workspace symbols. Disable to rely on VS Code's built-in providers instead.

internalDebug.description: Determines if the internal debugging information for the Deno language server will be logged to the _Deno Language Server_ console.

internalInspect.description: Enables the inspector server for the JS runtime used by the Deno Language Server to host its TS server. Optionally provide an address for the inspector listener e.g. "127.0.0.1:9222" (default).

logFile.description: Write logs to a file in a project-local directory.

defaultTaskCommand.description: Controls the default action when clicking on a task in the _Deno Tasks sidebar_.

autoBuild.description: Trigger ElixirLS build when code is saved

dialyzerEnabled.description: Run ElixirLS's rapid Dialyzer when code is saved

dialyzerWarnOpts.description: Dialyzer options to enable or disable warnings - See Dialyzer's documentation for options

dialyzerFormat.description: Formatter to use for Dialyzer warnings

envVariables.description: Environment variables to use for compilation

mixEnv.description: Mix environment to use for compilation

mixTarget.description: Mix target to use for compilation

projectDir.description: Subdirectory containing Mix project if not in the project root

stdlibSrcDir.description: Subdirectory where the Elixir stdlib resides to allow for source code lookup. E.g. /home/youruser/.asdf/installs/elixir/1.18.2

useCurrentRootFolderAsProjectDir.description: Don't try to look for mix.exs in parent directories

fetchDeps.description: Automatically fetch project dependencies when compiling.

suggestSpecs.description: Suggest @spec annotations inline using Dialyzer's inferred success typings (Requires Dialyzer).

server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Elixir language server.

autoInsertRequiredAlias.description: Enable auto-insert required alias. This is true (enabled) by default.

signatureAfterComplete.description: Show signature help after confirming autocomplete.

enableTestLenses.description: Show code lenses to run tests in terminal.

additionalWatchedExtensions.description: Additional file types capable of triggering a build on change

languageServerOverridePath.description: Absolute path to alternative ElixirLS release that will override the packaged release

dotFormatter.description: Path to a custom .formatter.exs file used when formatting documents

mcpEnabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server

mcpPort.description: Set a specific port for the MCP server. If not set, uses `3789 + hash(workspace_path)` for predictable port assignment per workspace
